external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and may use applications with the issued token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague of a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise's own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies group membership changes and leaver changes overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to vouch for their identities.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: own devices at home
external_entities.description: Devices from which colleagues may sign in while at home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: The broker signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, signs tokens, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize changing prices and voiding transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A key store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership comes from the HR system overnight, and the text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker from an own device at home.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the identity broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to the store admin console for the colleague's use.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: group membership changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The text says the broker pulls the changes, so the broker initiates this interaction.
data_flows.data_description: Group membership changes and leaver changes

data_flows.name: directory maintenance
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps and uses the signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: sign-in audit
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which the identity broker and store admin console run, and where the corporate directory, key store, and audit log are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the franchise stores, including franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it contains colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in; this is personal and access-related information.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key used to sign tokens.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker reads from and writes to the directory because it keeps directory records and incorporates overnight HR changes.
assumptions.basis: The source says the broker keeps colleagues and groups in the directory and pulls changes into that directory.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker reads from and writes to the key store because it keeps and uses the signing key stored there.
assumptions.basis: The source says the broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
